<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0232026-03-2016-20-17" status="unreviewed"> <note type="gloss">'di 'ang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">zhang ston</rs> nyid kyis lan 'debs pa yin</note>
               ma yin te tshad mas ngos su gzhal ba'i don kho na tshad ma'i yul
               <lb n="10b7"/> yin na bden ba shugs kyi yul yang tshad ma'i yul yin bas sgro 'dogs bsal ba'i gzhi de dag tshad ma zhugs pa'i yul nyid yin bas : tshad ma zhugs pa'i yul las yul gzhan la sgro 'dogs bsal bar ji ltar 'gyur | de ltar na tshad ma zhugs pa'i yul la tshad ma can gyi rgyud la tshad ma byed pa ma dong bo'i dus de nyid du dngos 'gal dang des khyad par du byas pa'i
               <lb n="10b8"/>brgyud 'agal du 'dzin pa'i the tsom dang zhen yul la phyin ci log du 'jug pa'i sgro 'dogs bgcad bya yin par bstan no ||</seg></TEI>
